mapper.insert: insert into exercise (ex_id, category, name, kcal_burn) values (#{ex_id},#{category},#{name},#{kcal_burn})
mapper.select: select nvl(count(*),0) from exercise where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

select * from ( select rownum rnum, data.* from( select ex_id, category, name, kcal_burn from exercise where ${searchKey} like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' order by ex_id desc) data)
where rnum>=#{start} and rnum<=#{end}
mapper.update: update exercise set ex_id=#{ex_id}, name=#{name}, kcal_burn=#{kcal_burn} where ex_id=#{ex_id}
